purpose: Candidate source list for the 14 web novels that were recorded but not imported in the 2026-06-10 fast batch.

sourceGovernance.rule: Candidate-only sources are search/review anchors. They must not be used by batch_runner.py or batch_apply.py as automated ingest sources until an adapter, field mapping, precheck rules, and documentation are added.
sourceGovernance.fallbackRule: Third-party fulltext/media pages may only be used as low-priority synopsis/story fallback after review; they must not be the sole source for title, author, cover, or primary metadata.

preferredSources: candidate-only sources only for human review, source hints, or future adapter development
third-party fulltext pages only as reviewed low-priority synopsis/story fallback
